name: context-checkpoint
description: Deliberate context compaction for Claude Code: a UserPromptSubmit hook that reads the live context size from the session transcript and, every N% of the window, after a cold-cache pause, or on a task-boundary prompt, decides whether to keep or compact — on relevance and freshness of what is in context, not its size. A cheap model digests the transcript into five lines (in flight / closed / stale / poison / next needs) for the console, and TypeSafe's Jev decision model grades that digest with calibrated probabilities; the hook combines the grades by arithmetic, with a loss-risk veto. Falls back to asking the session's own model when no key or no answer. Ships the hook, a per-machine config, --status and --dry-run readings, and a skill explaining the criteria and the measurements.
